style: Style: a UI element for an arcade ice-hockey video game in a painted-cel night look: flat saturated paint strokes with soft ink outlines, slate-grey and deep navy darks, chalk-white strokes, electric blue (#1D4ED8) and warm orange (#E8651A) accents only. Film-production motif: clapperboards, slate cards, film counters. The element is drawn once, centred, filling the frame, with a flat TRANSPARENT background (PNG alpha) outside its own shape and nothing else in the picture: no scene, no rink, no texture behind it, no drop shadow. Absolutely no lettering, digits or symbols unless the prompt spells them out. No real brands, teams, leagues, logos or people. Teen-appropriate.

jobs.name: panel-9slice
jobs.prompt: A UI panel for 9-slice scaling: one rounded rectangle filling the whole frame with a 4 percent margin, corner radius about 6 percent of the width, filled with flat dark slate (#1C1F26) at full opacity, a 2 percent thick chalk-white painted border with slightly uneven hand-drawn edges, the inside completely flat and uniform so text can sit on it. Nothing else.

jobs.name: score-plate
jobs.prompt: A scoreboard digit plate in a film-counter style: one horizontal rounded rectangle filling the frame with a 4 percent margin, filled with flat light chalk-grey (#E6E6E2) at full opacity, a thin dark ink border, two small film-counter notches at the left and right edges, the centre completely flat and empty so a large digit can be drawn on it by the game. Nothing else.

jobs.name: bubble-left
jobs.prompt: A comic speech bubble for a text line: one wide rounded bubble filling the frame with a 6 percent margin on top and sides, flat chalk-white fill (#F4F4F0) at full opacity, a 2 percent thick dark ink outline, and a short pointed tail at the BOTTOM LEFT that points down-left to the speaker below. The inside completely flat and empty. Nothing else.

jobs.name: call-card-frame
jobs.prompt: A card frame for a 'director's call' dialog: a slate-grey (#2A2E36) rounded card filling the frame with a 3 percent margin, a black-and-white diagonal clapper stripe band across the top 7 percent of the card, a thin chalk-white border, a small chalk megaphone doodle in the top-right corner, and the rest of the card flat and empty for sliders and text. Nothing else.

jobs.name: cut-card-frame

Nothing else.

jobs.prompt: A film-slate title card for an arcade ice-hockey game: a slate-grey clapperboard filling the frame, the black-and-white striped clapper across the top, and the big chalk letters HOKEJ written by hand across the middle of the slate, nothing under them. Behind the slate a night hockey rink seen from behind the net: blue and orange trim lights, four spot cones over scuffed ice, no crowd. Only this one word appears: HOKEJ. This card may have a full painted background instead of a transparent one.

Only the word MATCH appears. This card may have a full painted background (a night rink behind the slate) instead of a transparent one.
